Project name: ____________________
Contact person: ____________________

[ ] Scope & total cost
What will the first release include? List the price, payment milestones, hosting and recurring service costs. Agree how changes will be estimated before they are built.
Agreed notes: ____________________

[ ] Progress you can review
Choose who reviews each milestone, the workflows to demonstrate and the checks needed for acceptance. Record feedback and resolve the agreed issues before signing off.
Agreed notes: ____________________

[ ] Ownership & handover
Document who owns the domain, hosting, application accounts and business data. Specify source-code rights, third-party licences, data export, training and the handover format in your proposal.
Agreed notes: ____________________

[ ] Support after launch
Separate bug fixes from new features. Agree support hours, response targets, maintenance fees, backup responsibilities and how access is transferred if the engagement ends. Coverage follows the written plan.
Agreed notes: ____________________

For discussion; this checklist is not a signed proposal or purchase. Do not include passwords or private customer records.
